mapper.select: SELECT APPLICATION_ID, USER_ID, ACCOUNT_NUMBER, PRODUCT_ID, REQUEST_AMOUNT, LOAN_PERIOD, STATUS, REMAINING_BALANCE, REPAYMENT_TYPE, CREATED_AT FROM LOAN_APPLICATION WHERE APPLICATION_ID = #{applicationId}
SELECT APPLICATION_ID, USER_ID, ACCOUNT_NUMBER, PRODUCT_ID, REQUEST_AMOUNT, LOAN_PERIOD, STATUS, REMAINING_BALANCE, REPAYMENT_TYPE, CREATED_AT FROM LOAN_APPLICATION WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LOAN_APPLICATION (USER_ID, ACCOUNT_NUMBER, PRODUCT_ID, REQUEST_AMOUNT, LOAN_PERIOD, STATUS, REMAINING_BALANCE, REPAYMENT_TYPE, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{accountNumber}, #{productId}, #{requestAmount}, #{loanPeriod}, #{status}, #{remainingBalance}, #{repaymentType}, #{createdAt})
